E2-2023-T1-P1-S4.trunk: S+V+O：The RHS says it has introduced the ban（英国皇家园艺学会表示已实施禁令）
structure: 主句：The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS) says
├ 非限制性定语从句(which)：which runs the annual show in west London
└ 宾语从句：it has introduced the ban
└ 原因状语(because of)：because of the damage
└ 定语从句：plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity〔修饰 damage〕
E2-2023-T1-P1-S4.logic: which 从句补充学会身份；says 后给出其决定；because of 说明禁令缘由，其中 damage 后省略关系代词的定语从句指出受害对象。
notes: run the show 意为主办、运营花展。
do damage to 是固定搭配，表示对……造成损害。

E2-2023-T1-P1-S9.trunk: S+V+O：It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions（该账号正鼓励人们签署两份请愿书）
structure: 主句：It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions
同位解释1：one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass
并列同位解释2：another calling for an "ecological damage" tax on such lawns
E2-2023-T1-P1-S9.logic: 主句先给出行动目标；逗号后用 one...another...分别说明两份请愿书的诉求，两个 calling 均是现在分词后置修饰 petition。
notes: It 指上文的 Twitter account。
call for 意为呼吁、要求。
one...another... 对应“两者中的一份……另一份……”。

E2-2023-T1-P1-S16.trunk: S+V；S+V：The use must comply..., while measures should serve...（人造草使用必须合规，而相关措施应起到促进作用）
structure: 分句1：the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards
├ 过去分词短语：in place〔修饰 safeguards〕
└ 目的状语(to)：to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage
分句2(while)：while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve
└ 不定式：to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives
E2-2023-T1-P1-S16.logic: 前半句规定使用人造草的合规底线；while 连接另一层政策引导，强调措施还应促使公共机构主动选择可持续方案。
notes: safeguards in place 指已经生效或设置好的保障措施。
serve to do 表示“起到……作用”。
sustainable drainage 指减少积水和径流风险的可持续排水。
